threadError.localRuntimeOutdated.suggest: Update {{runtime}}, then retry. You can change the model or runtime in Settings > Profiles.
threadError.encryptedContentInvalid.mess: This conversation's data can no longer be verified by {{provider}} (organization mismatch).
threadError.encryptedContentInvalid.sugg: Start a new conversation. This one cannot be recovered.
threadError.lmStudioBackend.title: LM Studio backend failed to load
threadError.lmStudioBackend.message: LM Studio could not load the model engine. This is usually caused by a corrupted or incomplete backend installation.
threadError.lmStudioBackend.suggestion: In LM Studio, go to Settings > Engines & Frameworks and click "Fix" next to the MLX runtime, or update LM Studio to the latest version. See https://github.com/lmstudio-ai/lmstudio-bug-tracker/issues/1645
threadError.lmStudioNoModels.title: No models loaded in LM Studio
threadError.lmStudioNoModels.message: LM Studio is running but has no models loaded.
threadError.lmStudioNoModels.suggestion: Download a model in LM Studio, or switch to a different provider in Settings.
threadError.claudeCodeNotInstalled.title: Claude Code not installed
threadError.claudeCodeNotInstalled.messa: The Claude Code CLI is required.
threadError.acpNotAvailable.title: Agent not available
threadError.acpNotAvailable.message: The external agent could not be started.
threadError.acpNotAvailable.suggestion: Check that the CLI tool is installed.
threadError.lmStudioNotRunning.title: LM Studio is not running
threadError.lmStudioNotRunning.message: Interpreter could not connect to the LM Studio local server at http://localhost:1234.
threadError.lmStudioNotRunning.suggestio: Start LM Studio and enable its local server, or update the profile base URL in Settings.
threadError.ollamaNotRunning.title: Ollama is not running
threadError.ollamaNotRunning.message: Interpreter could not connect to the Ollama local server at http://localhost:11434.
threadError.ollamaNotRunning.suggestion: Start Ollama (for example with `ollama serve`) or update the profile base URL in Settings.
threadError.modelNoTools.title: Model does not support tools
threadError.localModelNoTools.message: This model does not support tool calling.
threadError.localModelNoTools.suggestion: Switch to a tool-capable model (e.g. Qwen 3, Llama 3.1+, Mistral) in Settings.
threadError.invalidModel.title: Invalid {{provider}} model ID
threadError.invalidModel.message: The model ID is not valid for {{provider}}.
threadError.modelCapabilitySuggestion: Switch to another model in Settings > Models.
threadError.modelNoImages.title: Model does not support images
threadError.unsupportedResponsesEndpoint: Provider URL does not support Responses API
Try switching to a natively supported provider in Settings > Profiles, such as Interpreter, Groq, OpenRouter, or OpenAI.
threadError.modelMissing.title: Model not found
threadError.modelMissing.message: The selected model was not found.
threadError.modelMissing.suggestion: Pull the model in Ollama, or select a different model in Settings.
threadError.providerNotConnected.message: The selected provider is not connected.
threadError.providerNotConnected.suggest: Connect the provider in Settings > Profiles, or switch to a different profile.
threadError.sessionExpired.title: Session expired
threadError.chatGptSessionExpired.title: {{provider}} session expired
threadError.freshThreadRequired.title: This chat needs a fresh thread
threadError.freshThreadRequired.message: This chat hit a resume bug while replaying earlier reasoning history.
threadError.freshThreadRequired.suggesti: Use "New Chat (with history)" to continue while preserving this conversation.
threadError.providerStreamDisconnected.m: The model provider connection ended before the response finished.
threadError.providerStreamDisconnected.s: Retry. If this keeps happening on the selected model, switch to Interpreter Smart or another model in Settings > Models.
threadError.contentFilter.message: The model output was blocked by a content filtering policy.
threadError.contentFilter.suggestion: Try rephrasing your request, reducing included source material, or starting a new conversation.
threadError.network.title: Connection problem
threadError.network.suggestion: Check your internet connection and try again.
threadError.localContextTooSmall.title: Model context length too small
threadError.contextOverflow.title: Conversation too long
threadError.contextOverflow.message: The conversation exceeded the model context limit.
threadError.contextOverflow.suggestion: Start a new conversation or use a model with a larger context window.
threadError.providerError.title: Provider error
threadError.providerError.message: The AI provider returned an error.
threadError.providerError.suggestion: This may be temporary. Try again, or start a new conversation if the problem persists.
threadError.unknown.title: Request failed
threadError.unknown.message: Interpreter did not receive a readable error message for this failed request.
threadError.unknown.suggestion: Try again, or start a new conversation if the problem persists.
threadError.profileSwitchWarning: We're aware of chat errors after switching profiles. Please report your error to help us fix them faster. In the meantime, you can start a new chat.
threadError.action.reportBugTooltip: Send a bug report with session details.
threadError.action.newChatWithHistoryToo: Start a fresh chat and preserve history.
